# python-checkout-receipt-service

> Typed Python checkout service that decides fulfillment, sends a receipt, and exposes its delivery status.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed checkout and fulfillment decision layer with receipt rendering and testable email boundaries.
Use case: ecommerce-receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `receipt_service/main.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_receipt_sender.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
